```llp
%% I step {D}.
move [dyn] : agent_at(C) * $next(C, D, C2) * floor(C2) -o agent_at(C2) * floor(C2).
```

```llp
%% I open the door {D}.
open [dyn] : $agent_at(C) * $next(C, D, C2) * door(C2, closed) -o door(C2, open).
```

```llp
%% I pick {O} up.
pickup [dyn] : $agent_at(C) * obj(O, C) -o holds(O).
```

```llp
%% I go down.
down [dyn] : agent_at(C) * $stairs_down(C) -o agent_at(C).
```

```llp
%% I unlock the door {D}.
apply [dyn] : $agent_at(C) * $next(C, D, C2) * door(C2, closed) -o door(C2, closed).
```
